annotations.title: Search US homes for rent or sale

description: US property listings for a city, ZIP code or search link, to rent or buy: address, price, beds, baths, size, property type, listing status, days on market, agent or broker, photos and link. Filters for price and rooms; newest first if asked. Runs the Apify Actor tacps126/realtor-scraper on your Apify account (about $0.001 per listing; spend per call is capped at $0.5).

extra_input.description: Advanced: extra Actor input fields, merged over the defaults.

locations.description: Cities or ZIP codes, e.g. ["Austin, TX"].

max_items.description: Maximum results to return (default 100, max 2000). Cost scales with this.

min_price.description: Lowest price (monthly rent or sale price, USD).

urls.description: Search result links copied from the site.

name: search_us_property_listings

count.description: Number of records the Actor returned.

items.description: The records. Long text fields are shortened to 600 characters.

shown.description: Number of records included in `items` (can be lower than count when the result is long).

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced the result.

truncated.description: True when records were left out to keep the result short; ask for fewer items.

title: Search US homes for rent or sale
